login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Keep your progress going.
login.googleTerms: If you do not have an account yet, continuing with Google creates one. By doing so, you confirm you are 18 or older, agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signup.title: Create account
signup.subtitle: Start for free. You can upgrade to Premium whenever you want.
signup.terms: By creating an account, you confirm you are 18 or older, agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and confirm you have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. This is a demo environment with no real charges.
signup.successDescription: If the address is valid, we sent a link to confirm your account.

forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.successDescription: If the address is registered, you will receive a link to reset your password.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.successDescription: Your password has been changed. You can continue now.
reset.noSession: The reset link has expired or is invalid.

google.unavailable: Google sign-in is not configured in this environment yet. Use email and password.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidCredentials: Incorrect email or password, or email not confirmed yet.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.providerUnavailable: This sign-in method is not available right now.
errors.oauth: We could not sign you in with the external provider. Please try again.
errors.callback: We could not complete authentication. Please sign in again.
errors.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.sessionRequired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.unknown: We could not complete the request. Try again in a moment.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
